en.t: The shape of the mountains in his hometown...

units.source_text: 然而，近来他的画里充满了无关的幻影。

en.t: Yet lately his paintings had been filled with unrelated phantoms.

units.source_text: 与其在梦幻中描绘家乡的山川，莫如把眼前的马粪画下来。

en.t: Rather than painting the mountains and rivers of his hometown in a dream, he would be better off painting the horse dung before his eyes.
